spans.s:
The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'it exists' after the words 1. ओजस् 2. सहस् and 3. अभस् being in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction.

Terms: ठक्

The affixes यत् and ख come with the force of मतुप् after the word ओजस् when 'a day' is meant.

Terms: यत् and ख

The Instrumental -3rd case endings after 1. ओजस् 2. सहस् 3. अम्भस् and 4. तमस् are not elided before the second member of a compound.

Terms: विभक्ति-Non-elision
